issues: The UI segments were grey generic dashboard placeholders; all three crops showed grey bars and told no story
The title cards were SHIP / FASTER / TODAY centred on black, in the same cool grey as the UI, so the colours never talked to each other
With 8f cards and 10–12f UI shots there was no cause and effect between UI segments, so it never read as 'the picture does something, the card says a word'
The closing wide was the same grey list with nothing to land on
changes: Custom look: title cards are full-bleed Klein blue with cream heavy type, and the UI is a dark week-view calendar 'Plover' (fictional), so cards and footage trade light/dark and warm/cool on every cut

Each UI segment does one thing: A is a wide ease-in push as the cursor heads for Design review, B is a 1.7x crop dragging it from Tuesday to Thursday (lift plus a dashed ghost in the old slot), C is a 2.2x crop where it lands with a bounce and an 'Everyone's free · invites sent' toast pops up; all crops use CSS zoom so text stays sharp

Title cards use a Swiss grid: left-aligned 300px 'Plan. / Move. / Done.' with a 01—03 page number, a hairline and a one-line footnote, and the third card is inverted (cream ground, blue type) as the climax; each only settles 1.05→1 in the first 5f and is otherwise still
Cuts are re-timed to 16/26/40/50/62/72: 10f cards, 12–16f UI shots, all hard cuts by conditional mounting
The closing wide shows the rearranged week with the toast, pushes 1→1.03 very slowly over 72–120f, then holds truly still for 45f
